name: csvtemplater
description: A utility for generating text from a CSV file using a template. The script reads a CSV table, replaces template tags like `{{column_name}}` with values from each row, and writes the result to an output file.

scripts.build: npm run build-winint && npm run build-tsc && npm run build-mkdir && npm run build-mkbundle && npm run build-mkbinary

author: Roman A. Nosov
